rule: Fixed 23 Nov BEFORE the edge model was trained. Candidates = LiTS patients 51-130 not in configs/lits_ext_split.json and never used to train or tune anything, with >= 1 tumour, <= 250 liver slices (time) and a real voxel spacing in the scan (identity-header masks excluded from selection). Order: most tumours under 10 mm first, then most tumours, then patient number; add patients until >= 100 tumours AND >= 10 patients. Counts are from the scan (mask header spacing); the conversion recomputes them.
why: The 20-patient set (lits + lits_ext) was seen when the edge model was designed, so it no longer gives an unbiased verdict for it.
